mapper.sql: SELECT DATA.* FROM ( SELECT '' AS ROWFLAG, ROWNUM AS RNUM, COUNT(*) OVER() TOTAL_RECORDS, DATA.* FROM (
mapper.select:
SELECT DAH.STDR_MT ,DAH.CUSTOMER_CODE ,DAH.SLE_PRIC_DOC ,DAH.SLE_PRIC_DOC_PRDLST ,DAH.COMPANY_CODE ,DAH.DIVISION_CODE ,DAH.ITEM_CODE ,DAH.CSTMR_ITEM ,DAH.PRIC_RQEST_DATE ,DAH.JDGMNT_TYPE ,DAH.XPORT_AT ,DAH.SA_SE ,DAH.ITEM_NM ,DAH.ITEM_GROUP ,DAH.DRWBAK_SE_CODE ,DAH.GOODS_AT ,DAH.BASS_UNIT ,DAH.REAL_PRIC_RQEST_QY ,DAH.ACPLC_CRNCY_AMOUNT ,DAH.STTEMNT_PC_KRW ,DAH.DRWBAK_AMOUNT ,DAH.DRWBAK_DDC_AMOUNT ,DAH.DRWBAK_TRMMG_AMOUNT ,DAH.HS_CODE ,DAH.NATION_CODE ,DAH.ACPLC_CRNCY ,DAH.KRW_CRNCY ,DAH.EXECUT_AT ,DAH.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO ,DAH.XPORT_SE ,DAH.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO ,DAH.LNE_NO ,DAH.ROW1 ,DAH.DSPTH_DATE ,DAH.TRNSMIS_ID ,DAH.REF_GU_ID FROM DRWBAK_AMOUNT_HDER DAH WHERE 1=1
AND DAH.STDR_MT >= REPLACE(#{STDR_MT}, '-', '')
AND DAH.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND DAH.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND DAH.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND DAH.SLE_PRIC_DOC = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND DAH.SLE_PRIC_DOC LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND DAH.SLE_PRIC_DOC LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND DAH.CUSTOMER_CODE = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND DAH.CUSTOMER_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND DAH.CUSTOMER_CODE LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'

SELECT RIL.GU_ID_NO ,RIL.SEQ ,RIL.SUB_SEQ ,RIL.EFECT_BGNDE ,RIL.ITEM_CODE ,RIL.COMPANY_CODE ,RIL.STDR_MT ,RIL.ITEM_NM ,RIL.HS_CODE ,RIL.RAWMTRL_SE ,RIL.IMPDEC_NO ,RIL.LNE_NO ,RIL.POUCH_NO ,RIL.QY ,RIL.CSTMS ,RIL.CSTMS_AMOUNT ,RIL.CSTMS_AMOUNT_UNIT ,RIL.DLIVY_QY ,RIL.DLIVY_AMOUNT ,RIL.BASS_UNIT ,RIL.ACPLC_CRNCY ,RIL.INCME_THNG_ID FROM RAWMTRL_INCME_LOCAL_SM RIL WHERE 1=1
AND RIL.STDR_MT >= REPLACE(#{STDR_MT}, '-', '')

SELECT CCD.BASIS_DTA_MANAGE_NO ,CCD.LNE_NO ,CCD.POUCH_NO ,CCD.VENDOR_CODE ,CCD.RAWMTRL_SE ,CCD.CTRM_REGIST_NO ,CCD.ACPT_DATE ,CCD.TRNSFR_DATE ,CCD.PAPERS_SE ,CCD.BASIS_DOC_NO ,CCD.ITEM_CODE ,CCD.ITEM_NM ,CCD.HS_CODE ,CCD.QY ,CCD.BASS_UNIT ,CCD.INCME_TARRATE ,CCD.CSTMS ,CCD.ECX_AMOUNT ,CCD.INTTAX ,CCD.AGSPT ,CCD.TOT_TAXAMT ,CCD.ACPLC_CRNCY ,CCD.TRANTAX ,CCD.LQTX_AMOUNT FROM CCPY_CSTMR_DMSTC CCD WHERE 1=1
AND CCD.ACPT_DATE >= REPLACE(#{ACPT_DATE}, '-', '')
AND CCD.VENDOR_CODE = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND CCD.VENDOR_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND CCD.VENDOR_CODE LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND CCD.ITEM_CODE = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND CCD.ITEM_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND CCD.ITEM_CODE LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'

SELECT CCD.STDR_MT ,CCD.REPRSNT_CUSTOMER_CODE ,CCD.VENDOR_CODE ,CCD.PAPERS_SE ,CCD.BASIS_DOC_NO ,CCD.ITEM_CODE ,CCD.CSTMR_ITEM ,CCD.ITEM_NM ,CCD.BASS_UNIT ,CCD.QY ,CCD.CHIT_FRMTRM_DATE ,CCD.UNTPC ,CCD.ACPLC_CRNCY ,CCD.ACPLC_CRNCY_AMOUNT ,CCD.CSTMS_AMOUNT FROM CTRM_CSTMR_DMSTC CCD WHERE 1=1
AND CCD.STDR_MT >= REPLACE(#{STDR_MT}, '-', '')
AND CCD.REPRSNT_CUSTOMER_CODE = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND CCD.REPRSNT_CUSTOMER_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND CCD.REPRSNT_CUSTOMER_CODE LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND CCD.CSTMR_ITEM = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND CCD.CSTMR_ITEM LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND CCD.CSTMR_ITEM LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'

SELECT '수입' AS SEARCH_GUBUN , IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO AS MANAGE_NO , LNE_NO , POUCH_NO , ACPT_DATE , HS_CODE , ITEM_CODE , ITEM_NM , QY || '(' || BASS_UNIT || ')' AS ITEM_QTY , CVODV_KRW AS AMOUNT FROM IMPDEC_CERFIN_ITEM I WHERE I.ACPT_DATE BETWEEN #{SEARCH_FROM_DATE} AND #{SEARCH_TO_DATE} AND I.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT ICI.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO , ICI.LNE_NO , ICI.POUCH_NO FROM IMPDEC_CERFIN_ITEM ICI WHERE ICI.ACPT_DATE BETWEEN #{SEARCH_FROM_DATE} AND #{SEARCH_TO_DATE} GROUP BY ICI.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO , ICI.LNE_NO , ICI.POUCH_NO HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) T WHERE T.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO = I.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO AND T.LNE_NO = I.LNE_NO AND T.POUCH_NO = I.POUCH_NO)
AND I.ITEM_CODE = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND I.ITEM_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND I.ITEM_CODE LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND I.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND I.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND I.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
ORDER BY IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO, LNE_NO, POUCH_NO

SELECT '수출' AS SEARCH_GUBUN , EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO AS MANAGE_NO , LNE_NO , POUCH_NO , DSPTH_DATE AS ACPT_DATE , HS_CODE , ITEM_CODE , ITEM_NM , ITEM_QTY || '(' || SLE_UNIT || ')' AS ITEM_QTY , STTEMNT_PC_KRW AS AMOUNT FROM EXPORT_CERT_MST I WHERE I.DSPTH_DATE BETWEEN #{SEARCH_FROM_DATE} AND #{SEARCH_TO_DATE} AND I.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT ICI.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO , ICI.LNE_NO , ICI.POUCH_NO FROM EXPORT_CERT_MST ICI WHERE ICI.DSPTH_DATE BETWEEN #{SEARCH_FROM_DATE} AND #{SEARCH_TO_DATE} GROUP BY ICI.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO , ICI.LNE_NO , ICI.POUCH_NO HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) T WHERE T.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO = I.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO AND T.LNE_NO = I.LNE_NO AND T.POUCH_NO = I.POUCH_NO)
AND I.ITEM_CODE = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND I.ITEM_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND I.ITEM_CODE LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND I.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO}
AND I.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO}|| '%'
AND I.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO} || '%'
ORDER BY EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO, LNE_NO, POUCH_NO

SELECT '수입' AS GUBUN , IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO , ACPT_DATE , HS_CODE , ITEM_CODE , ITEM_NM AS ITEM_NAME , UNIT_PRICE AS ITEM_PRICE , QY || '(' || BASS_UNIT || ')' AS ITEM_QTY , CVODV_KRW AS ITEM_AMOUNT FROM IMPDEC_CERFIN_ITEM I WHERE 1=1 AND I.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND I.ACPT_DATE BETWEEN #{SEARCH_FROM_DATE} AND #{SEARCH_TO_DATE}
AND I.ITEM_CODE = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND I.ITEM_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND I.ITEM_CODE LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND I.ITEM_NM = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND I.ITEM_NM LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND I.ITEM_NM LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND I.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO}
AND I.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO}|| '%'
AND I.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO} || '%'
ORDER BY ITEM_CODE, HS_CODE, IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO
ORDER BY ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO
ORDER BY ITEM_CODE, UNIT_PRICE DESC
ORDER BY IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO, ACPT_DATE, ITEM_CODE

SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT B.* , MAX(RANK) OVER (PARTITION BY ITEM_CODE) MAX_RANK FROM ( SELECT A.* , RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY ITEM_CODE ORDER BY A.HS_CODE_CNT DESC) AS RANK FROM (SELECT '수입' AS GUBUN , IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO , ACPT_DATE , HS_CODE , ITEM_CODE , ITEM_NM AS ITEM_NAME , UNIT_PRICE AS ITEM_PRICE , QY || '(' || BASS_UNIT || ')' AS ITEM_QTY , CVODV_KRW AS ITEM_AMOUNT , COUNT(HS_CODE) OVER(PARTITION BY ITEM_CODE, HS_CODE) AS HS_CODE_CNT FROM IMPDEC_CERFIN_ITEM I WHERE 1=1 AND I.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND I.ACPT_DATE BETWEEN #{SEARCH_FROM_DATE} AND #{SEARCH_TO_DATE} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT ITEM_CODE , COUNT(DISTINCT HS_CODE) FROM IMPDEC_CERFIN_ITEM C WHERE 1=1 AND C.ACPT_DATE BETWEEN #{SEARCH_FROM_DATE} AND #{SEARCH_TO_DATE} GROUP BY ITEM_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT HS_CODE) >= 2 ) T WHERE T.ITEM_CODE = I.ITEM_CODE ) ) A ) B ) T WHERE (T.RANK <> 1 OR (T.RANK=1 AND T.MAX_RANK = 1 ))
AND T.ITEM_CODE = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND T.ITEM_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND T.ITEM_CODE LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND T.ITEM_NAME = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND T.ITEM_NAME LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND T.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND T.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO}
AND T.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO}|| '%'
AND T.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO} || '%'
ORDER BY ITEM_CODE, RANK

SELECT T.* FROM ( SELECT B.* , MAX(RANK) OVER (PARTITION BY ITEM_CODE) MAX_RANK FROM ( SELECT A.* , RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY ITEM_CODE ORDER BY A.ITEM_NM_CNT DESC) AS RANK FROM ( SELECT '수입' AS GUBUN , IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO , ACPT_DATE , HS_CODE , ITEM_CODE , ITEM_NM AS ITEM_NAME , UNIT_PRICE AS ITEM_PRICE , QY || '(' || BASS_UNIT || ')' AS ITEM_QTY , CVODV_KRW AS ITEM_AMOUNT , COUNT(ITEM_NM) OVER(PARTITION BY ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NM) AS ITEM_NM_CNT , COUNT(DISTINCT ITEM_NM) OVER(PARTITION BY ITEM_CODE, HS_CODE) AS ITEM_NM_DUPCNT FROM IMPDEC_CERFIN_ITEM I WHERE 1=1 AND I.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND I.ACPT_DATE BETWEEN #{SEARCH_FROM_DATE} AND #{SEARCH_TO_DATE} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT ITEM_CODE , COUNT(DISTINCT ITEM_NM) FROM IMPDEC_CERFIN_ITEM C WHERE 1=1 AND C.ACPT_DATE BETWEEN #{SEARCH_FROM_DATE} AND #{SEARCH_TO_DATE} GROUP BY ITEM_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ITEM_NM) >= 2 ) T WHERE T.ITEM_CODE = I.ITEM_CODE ) ) A ) B ) T WHERE (T.RANK <> 1 OR (T.RANK=1 AND T.MAX_RANK = 1 ))
AND T.ITEM_CODE = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND T.ITEM_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND T.ITEM_CODE LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND T.ITEM_NAME = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND T.ITEM_NAME LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND T.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND T.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO}
AND T.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO}|| '%'
AND T.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO} || '%'
ORDER BY ITEM_CODE, RANK

SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT '수입' AS GUBUN , IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO , ACPT_DATE , HS_CODE , ITEM_CODE , ITEM_NM AS ITEM_NAME , UNIT_PRICE AS ITEM_PRICE , QY || '(' || BASS_UNIT || ')' AS ITEM_QTY , CVODV_KRW AS ITEM_AMOUNT -- , MEDIAN(UNIT_PRICE) OVER(PARTITION BY ITEM_CODE) AS MID -- 중위값 FROM IMPDEC_CERFIN_ITEM I WHERE 1=1 AND I.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND I.ACPT_DATE BETWEEN #{SEARCH_FROM_DATE} AND #{SEARCH_TO_DATE} AND I.UNIT_PRICE <> 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT ITEM_CODE , MAX(UNIT_PRICE) AS MAX_PRICE , MIN(UNIT_PRICE) AS MIN_PRICE FROM IMPDEC_CERFIN_ITEM C WHERE 1=1 AND C.ACPT_DATE BETWEEN #{SEARCH_FROM_DATE} AND #{SEARCH_TO_DATE} AND UNIT_PRICE <> 0 GROUP BY ITEM_CODE HAVING (MAX(UNIT_PRICE) / MIN(UNIT_PRICE)) >= #{PRICE_DIFF_RANGE} ) T WHERE T.ITEM_CODE = I.ITEM_CODE ) ) A WHERE 1=1 -- AND (ITEM_PRICE > MID * 1.1 OR ITEM_PRICE < MID * 0.9)
AND A.ITEM_CODE = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND A.ITEM_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND A.ITEM_CODE LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND A.ITEM_NAME = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND A.ITEM_NAME LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND A.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND A.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO}
AND A.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO}|| '%'
AND A.IMPDEC_MANAGE_NO LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO} || '%'
ORDER BY ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_PRICE DESC

SELECT '수출' AS GUBUN , E.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO , E.LNE_NO , E.POUCH_NO , E.MANUFAC_NAME , E.RQST_PRSN_CODE , C.CODE_NM AS RQST_PRSN_NAME , E.DSPTH_DATE , E.HS_CODE , E.ITEM_CODE , E.ITEM_NM , E.ITEM_QTY || '(' || E.SLE_UNIT || ')' AS ITEM_QTY , E.STTEMNT_PC_KRW AS ITEM_AMOUNT ,(SELECT SUM(DRWBAK_AMOUNT) FROM DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_TRGET_THNG A , DRWBAK_REQSTDOC_INCME_RAWMTRL B WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.PRESENTN_NO = B.PRESENTN_NO AND A.THNG_SEQ = B.THNG_SEQ AND A.XPORT_STTEMNT_NO = E.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO AND A.ITEM_CODE = E.ITEM_CODE) AS DRWBACK_AMOUNT FROM EXPORT_CERT_MST E INNER JOIN COM_CD C ON E.RQST_PRSN_CODE = C.CODE_CD AND C.CATEGORY_CD ='RQST' WHERE E.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND E.XPORT_SE IN ('11','17','31') AND E.RQST_PRSN_CODE = '2' AND E.MANUFAC_NAME <> '(주)아모레퍼시픽' AND E.DSPTH_DATE BETWEEN #{SEARCH_FROM_DATE} AND #{SEARCH_TO_DATE} AND E.RQST_PRSN_CODE LIKE #{RQST_PRSN_CODE} || '%'
AND E.ITEM_CODE = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}
AND E.ITEM_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND E.ITEM_CODE LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD}|| '%'
AND E.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO}
AND E.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO}|| '%'
AND E.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_NO}|| '%'
AND E.MANUFAC_NAME = #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_MAKER}
AND E.MANUFAC_NAME LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_MAKER}|| '%'
AND E.MANUFAC_NAME LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_MAKER}|| '%'
ORDER BY E.EXPDECL_MANAGE_NO, E.LNE_NO, E.POUCH_NO

SELECT COMPANY_CODE , DIVISION_CODE , PRODUCT_CODE , PRODUCT_NAME , BOM_VERSION , CASE WHEN NEW_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'V' END AS NEW_CHANGE_FLAG , CASE WHEN DELETE_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'V' END AS DELETE_CHANGE_FLAG , CASE WHEN QTY_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'V' END AS QTY_CHANGE_FLAG , CASE WHEN UNIT_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'V' END AS UNIT_CHANGE_FLAG FROM (SELECT T1.COMPANY_CODE , T1.DIVISION_CODE , T1.PRODUCT_CODE , P.ITEM_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME , T1.CURR_USE_BOM_VERSION AS BOM_VERSION , MAX(NEW_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME) AS NEW_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME , MAX(DELETE_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME) AS DELETE_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME , MAX(QTY_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME) AS QTY_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME , MAX(UNIT_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME) AS UNIT_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME FROM TABLE(FN_GET_DIFF_BOM(#{COMPANY_CODE}, #{DIVISION_CODE}, #{SEARCH_YYYY}, #{SEARCH_QUARTER}, #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_PRODUCT_CODE}, #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_ITEM_CODE})) T1 LEFT OUTER JOIN ITEM_MST P ON T1.PRODUCT_CODE = P.ITEM_CODE AND T1.COMPANY_CODE = P.COMPANY_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ITEM_MST CI ON T1.CURR_ITEM_CODE = CI.ITEM_CODE AND T1.COMPANY_CODE = CI.COMPANY_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ITEM_MST PI ON T1.PAST_ITEM_CODE = PI.ITEM_CODE AND T1.COMPANY_CODE = PI.COMPANY_CODE WHERE T1.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND T1.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} GROUP BY T1.COMPANY_CODE , T1.DIVISION_CODE , T1.PRODUCT_CODE , P.ITEM_NAME , T1.CURR_USE_BOM_VERSION ) P WHERE 1=1
AND NEW_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME IS NOT NULL
AND NEW_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME IS NULL

SELECT T1.COMPANY_CODE , T1.DIVISION_CODE , T1.PRODUCT_CODE , T1.CURR_ITEM_CODE , CI.ITEM_NAME AS CURR_ITEM_NMAE , T1.CURR_INPUT_QTY , T1.CURR_INPUT_BASS_UNIT , T1.CURR_USE_BOM_VERSION AS CURR_BOM_VERSION , T1.PAST_ITEM_CODE , PI.ITEM_NAME AS PAST_ITEM_NMAE , T1.PAST_INPUT_QTY , T1.PAST_INPUT_BASS_UNIT , T1.PAST_USE_BOM_VERSION AS PAST_BOM_VERSION , CASE WHEN T1.NEW_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'V' END AS NEW_CHANGE_FLAG , CASE WHEN T1.DELETE_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'V' END AS DELETE_CHANGE_FLAG , CASE WHEN T1.QTY_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'V' END AS QTY_CHANGE_FLAG , CASE WHEN T1.UNIT_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'V' END AS UNIT_CHANGE_FLAG FROM TABLE(FN_GET_DIFF_BOM(#{COMPANY_CODE}, #{DIVISION_CODE}, #{SEARCH_YYYY}, #{SEARCH_QUARTER}, #{GRID_PRODUCT_CODE}, '')) T1 LEFT OUTER JOIN ITEM_MST CI ON T1.CURR_ITEM_CODE = CI.ITEM_CODE AND T1.COMPANY_CODE = CI.COMPANY_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ITEM_MST PI ON T1.PAST_ITEM_CODE = PI.ITEM_CODE AND T1.COMPANY_CODE = PI.COMPANY_CODE WHERE T1.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND T1.DIVISION_CODE = #{DIVISION_CODE} AND T1.CURR_USE_BOM_VERSION = #{GRID_BOM_VERSION}
AND (T1.CURR_ITEM_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_ITEM_CODE} || '%' OR T1.PAST_ITEM_CODE LIKE #{SEARCH_KEY_WORD_ITEM_CODE} || '%')
AND T1.NEW_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME IS NOT NULL
AND T1.NEW_CHANGE_FLAG_NAME IS NULL
